title: Read a NumPy array from bytes — npy_decode
text: Types map follows: b1 logical; i1, u1, i2, u2 i4 integer; u4, f2, f4 f8 double; i8 u8 double, integer64 int64 = "integer64"; c8 c16 complex. Every value converted exactly refused: i4 -2^31 R's NA_integer_, error unless na = "allow", 64-bit integer beyond 2^53 magnitude, double hold exactly, error unless int64 = "integer64". String, date-time, void structured dtypes supported yet. 0-d array becomes length-1 vector 1-d array vector, without dim. NumPy's default C order (last index fastest) permuted R's column-major order, [, j] R [-1, j-1] Python; order = "file" skips permutation returns array dimensions reversed, memory identical file's.

title: Read a NumPy array from bytes — npy_decode
code: # A 2 x 3 little-endian double matrix in C order, as numpy.save() writes it. dict <- "{'descr': '<f8', 'fortran_order': False, 'shape': (2, 3), }" pad <- (64 - (10 + nchar(dict) + 1) %% 64) %% 64 header <- c(charToRaw(dict), rep(charToRaw(" "), pad), charToRaw("\n")) x <- c(as.raw(c(0x93, 0x4e, 0x55, 0x4d, 0x50, 0x59, 1, 0)),        as.raw(c(length(header), 0)), header,        writeBin(as.double(0:5), raw(), size = 8, endian = "little")) npy_decode(x) #>      [,1] [,2] [,3] #> [1,]    0    1    2 #> [2,]    3    4    5

title: Write an R array as NumPy bytes — npy_encode
text: default dtype follows R type (see npy_dtype()): logical |b1, integer <i4, double <f8 (whole numbers ), complex <c16, raw |u1 integer64 <i8. dtype chooses another numeric dtype one call: value fit error naming index, never wrap rounding integer; floats round nearest even. Multi-byte dtypes always little-endian. NA place NumPy types. logical NA error unless na = "allow", writes False warning; integer NA error unless na = "allow", writes -2147483648 <i4 (R reads back NA) NaN float. double NA written bit bit <f8, R reads back NA NumPy sees NaN. matrix array written R's (Fortran) order fortran_order set, costs copy; order = "C" writes C order readers need . dimnames names dropped. length-1 vector 1-d array one element: R 0-d array.

title: Write an R array as NumPy bytes — npy_encode
code: x <- matrix(c(1.5, 2, 3, 4), 2) bytes <- npy_encode(x) identical(npy_decode(bytes), x) #> [1] TRUE npy_header(bytes)$descr #> [1] "<f8" npy_header(npy_encode(1:3, dtype = "|u1"))$descr #> [1] "|u1"

title: Read the header of a NumPy array — npy_header
code: dict <- "{'descr': '<i4', 'fortran_order': False, 'shape': (3,), }" pad <- (64 - (10 + nchar(dict) + 1) %% 64) %% 64 header <- c(charToRaw(dict), rep(charToRaw(" "), pad), charToRaw("\n")) x <- c(as.raw(c(0x93, 0x4e, 0x55, 0x4d, 0x50, 0x59, 1, 0)),        as.raw(c(length(header), 0)), header) npy_header(x) #> $version #> [1] "1.0" #>  #> $descr #> [1] "<i4" #>  #> $fortran_order #> [1] FALSE #>  #> $shape #> [1] 3 #>  #> $itemsize #> [1] 4 #>  #> $data_offset #> [1] 128 #>

title: Conditions raised by zunpy — zunpy-conditions
text: Every error zunpy raises carries condition class, can caught kind rather matching message, may change. Every class inherits zunpy_error. Offsets 0-based byte offsets input; .npz count start member, member names .

title: Conditions raised by zunpy — zunpy-conditions
text: zunpy_invalid_argument argument unusable, including dtype value reach. Carries arg. zunpy_parse_error input .npy .npz: bad magic string, version, header grammar descr, truncated trailing data. Carries offset. zunpy_invalid_error input well formed inconsistent: shape disagrees data length, fields overlap, U string holds surrogate, checksum match. Carries offset. zunpy_unsupported_type dtype R value counterpart: object arrays, long doubles, nested structured dtypes. Carries dtype. zunpy_unrepresentable value R hold: dimension 2^31 - 1, 64-bit integer beyond 2^53 read double. Carries offset index. zunpy_na_error NA representation target. Carries index. zunpy_range_error value fit requested dtype. Carries index. zunpy_limit_error limit reached. Carries limit, argument's name, limit_value. subclasses zunpy_size_limit, zunpy_header_limit, zunpy_dims_limit zunpy_members_limit. zunpy_io_error file connection read written. Warnings inherit zunpy_warning: zunpy_byte_order dtype gives byte order native (=) , NumPy never writes read little-endian; zunpy_alignment data starts multiple 16 bytes 64, files NumPy 1.14 writers .

title: Conditions raised by zunpy — zunpy-conditions
code: e <- tryCatch(   stop(structure(     class = c("zunpy_parse_error", "zunpy_error", "error", "condition"),     list(message = "not a .npy file", call = NULL, offset = 0)   )),   zunpy_error = function(e) e ) class(e) #> [1] "zunpy_parse_error" "zunpy_error"       "error"             #> [4] "condition"         e$offset #> [1] 0
